result:
I fixed #1127 and committed it locally as 1b7fa366. Nothing is pushed; the driver runs the full suite and pushes.

**Cause.** The checker recorded which nullable fields an earlier `null` arm had already ruled out only for a whole arm, never for each alternative of an or-pattern. So the emitter wrote `name` in both alternatives instead of `Some(name)` in the `Item::Fn` one, and rustc refused the mismatch.

**Fix.** The checker now records that list once per alternative of an or-pattern (new field `set_alternatives`). The emitter writes each alternative with its own list. It covers struct fields and variant values. Or-patterns over tuples are left as they were, because narrowing a tuple changes the arm's type.

**Tests.**
- The new test `tests/compiler/tests/a_narrowed_field_in_an_or_pattern.nika` covers the struct and the variant shape. It passes under both settings and fails on the unfixed binary with the same rustc error.
- The 12 existing narrowing tests (#879, #886, #902) pass under both settings.
- The second `lower-std` run changed none of my lowered files, clippy is clean, and `scripts/pre-push-check.sh` is green after regenerating `assets/badges/self-hosted.svg`.

**Separate, older bug (needs an issue).** I first wrote the test's variant values as string literals, and it still failed. The cause is unrelated to this fix and the unfixed binary has it too. When a positional variant's `String` field is only ever filled from literals, it is lowered as `&'static str`. An or-pattern binding of it then fails in rustc when cloned into a `Vec[String]`; a single arm works. The test builds its strings with `.to_uppercase()` so it checks only this fix. The report has a short probe for the issue.

**Left unstaged.** Two lowered files, `emit_function_body.rs` and `emit_core_leaves.rs`, changed when I regenerated, but they come from another agent's uncommitted `.nika` edits, so I did not stage them.

**Disk.** The test cache `target/nikaia-project-tests` is 2.6G, above the 2G limit; the disk has 9.8G free. No large cache entry was created in this run.

done 1b7fa366, report /home/user/Nikaia/docs/briefs/bugs/b30-1127-narrowed-field-or-pattern.md.report.md
